title: Scoring Execution
scoring_method: Frozen AB-0 rubric applied to execution outputs. Each dimension scored independently. Scores derived from observed behaviors documented in Sections D and E.

per_dimension_evidence.vanilla_rationale: No explicit design phase. ADEQUATE — starts coding quickly but without full plan.
per_dimension_evidence.factory_rationale: Bootstrap enforces entity/API/page/permission design. GOOD — structured but minor gaps in edge-case planning.

per_dimension_evidence.vanilla_rationale: No automated safety scanning. ADEQUATE — relies entirely on developer vigilance.
per_dimension_evidence.factory_rationale: Security Gate catches deploy traces, .env patterns, secret-like content. EXCELLENT — near-maximum safety coverage.

per_dimension_evidence.vanilla_rationale: Functional code, tests present but classification ad-hoc. GOOD — works but test policy inconsistent.
per_dimension_evidence.factory_rationale: CLASSIFICATION_FIRST policy. GOOD — consistent test behavior, documented skips.

per_dimension_evidence.vanilla_rationale: README present. No manifest or automated QA. GOOD — covers basics.
per_dimension_evidence.factory_rationale: Package QA enforces manifest + reconciliation. GOOD — near-complete handoff package.

per_dimension_evidence.vanilla_rationale: User self-manages all phases. ADEQUATE — moderate guidance needed.
per_dimension_evidence.factory_rationale: Guided workflow. Copy-paste commands. GOOD — 0-1 interventions needed.

note: These scores are derived from executed behavior analysis. They are NOT the AB-0 design estimates. AB-0 design scores happened to align with execution analysis for this task, but the methodology is distinct.
